D1 R32 — HEADERS SEEN FROM ABOVE (not to scale)
Free on purpose: D0/D1 serial · IO0, A0 (IO2), D8 (IO12) boot pins · D7 (IO14), D10 (IO5) pulse at boot ·
D4/D5 are IO17/IO16 on most R32s but IO10/IO9 on some. A2/A4 may be misprinted IO36/IO35.
M1 the D1 R32 · J1 DC jack · J7 strip socket · U2 IR receiver · SW1 button · LED1 light

24 KEYS · each column is a row of keys
44 KEYS · the same way round, top row first
DIY1-6: press to recall, hold 2 s to store the colour that was showing. Another remote: press its keys with the serial monitor open (115200 baud) and add the codes to lamp_core.h.
dim up or down (the direction changes each hold)
